reserveReview.rationale: Standing-structure renewal 2026-11-19: Trevee still publishes no dated constituent weights. The treasury/backing-address and collateral-vault pages (fetched 2026-11-19; page revisions dated 2025-10-02) still route every accepted stablecoin (USDC, USDT, DAI, GHO, Sonic USDC.e) into the single Ethereum Veda BoringVault deployed across whitelisted lending/staking strategies. An Etherscan read of the scUSD BoringVault contract as of 2026-11-19 18:05 UTC confirms the verified vault remains live (596 transactions), and DefiLlama corroborates circulating contracted to roughly $0.34M after Stream-Finance-era redemptions. Idle explorer balances are still not a full composition (strategies hold aTokens and other positions off bare ERC-20 balances), so the envelope remains one explicit 100% mixed basket with knownUnknownExposurePct 100 rather than fabricated constituent weights. Structure unchanged from the 2026-07-30 review; the conservative high risk tier is retained, so re-dating cannot improve the score through favorable tiers.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-documented standing structure re-verified 2026-11-19: Trevee documents the single Ethereum Veda BoringVault as the route for backing assets; no dated issuer weight table exists
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current balances by accepted stablecoin, lending protocol, and strategy are still not published in a source suitable for a defensible static split; the issuer publishes backing addresses and live wallet explorers rather than a dated weight table, and idle ERC-20 balances omit strategy positions.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Trevee publishes dedicated BoringVault backing addresses and states funds are deployed across protocols. LlamaRisk notes aToken rehypothecation risk in lending strategies. Neither source publishes current chain shares, strategy shares, enforceable holder-benefit legal segregation or bankruptcy-remoteness terms, or a complete controller/custodian inventory. Source-scope correction verified 2026-10-20: dedicated onchain addresses establish technical separation, not legal segregation; the unsupported segregated label is withdrawn without renewing the original 2026-07-30 review or changing the permitted-rehypothecation fact.
